predictions.rationale: The error is related to parsing the header of a tar archive, and TarArchiveInputStream is the class responsible for reading tar files.
TarUtils may contain utility methods that are used by TarArchiveInputStream to handle tar file headers.
TarArchiveEntry represents an entry in a tar archive, and issues with the header might affect how entries are parsed.
TarConstants defines constants used in tar file parsing, and any issues with the header might involve these constants.
Although the error is related to tar, the issue might be similar to zip parsing, and ZipArchiveInputStream could provide insights.
Similar to TarArchiveEntry, ZipArchiveEntry might also be involved in parsing archive headers.
ByteUtils provides utility methods for handling bytes, which might be used in parsing archive headers.
IOUtils provides utility methods for input/output operations, which might be used in reading archive headers.
Unit tests for TarArchiveInputStream might contain test cases that cover parsing of malformed headers.
Unit tests for TarArchiveEntry might contain test cases that cover parsing of archive headers.
